stem_book: An ideal massless spring S can be compressed 1 m by a force of 100 N in equilibrium. The same spring is placed at the bottom of a frictionless inclined plane inclined at 30° to the horizontal. A 10 kg block M is released from rest at the top of the incline and is brought to rest momentarily after compressing the spring by 2 m. If g = 10 m/s², what is the speed of the mass just before it touches the spring? (a) √20 m/s (b) √30 m/s (c) √10 m/s (d) √40 m/s
